# Hospeco Brands

> > Hospeco Brands provides janitorial supplies, industrial wiping solutions, and air freshener products for commercial and industrial facilities.

The site offers a comprehensive catalog of cleaning and facility maintenance products including urinal screens, air freshener dispensers, absorbent wipers, and centerfeed rolls. Key product lines include ShopWorks Absorbal wipers, Airofresh Pulse dispensers, and STRATUS3 deodorizing systems.
